title: CULT.AF.B.------POL.P.
description: First of two diagrams in PR.S(RD)II-5. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'The distortions that have crept into western analysis can be viewed by understanding the essence premise that dictates its information degrees.' The crossing diagrams how culture-affinity-basis structurally meets political-policies at the western-analysis scale: CULT-AF-B crossed with POL-P. CULT-AF-B sits at lower-right with the subject-arrow; POL-P at upper-right as partner-axis. PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics), AF-NT (affinity nature), (R)INTR (reality of interpretation) upper-center to upper-right. INFO-F (information focus), RTD-PRD (related procedure) center. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), WO-EXP-PR (world expansion principle) at left. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), POL-DY (political dynamics), LK-IMP (linkage implications) at lower-center.
